rationale: Price has made four successive lower closes on 1-minute bars since entry while hugging the 9-EMA at $54.29 with shrinking volume (down to 212 shares last bar). It has failed to produce any meaningful extension above the $55.00 high or the entry level, with maximum favorable excursion of only +0.04 %. Although still above VWAP and in the upper 82.8 % of the daily range, the lack of continued absorption and steady offer pressure supply mechanical reason to exit rather than hold or reverse.
